objective: Follow up on the remaining no-family-growth runtime cases after the 0.17.0 post-release triage: arrow residual class-data cost and minio.
reason_no_code_change: The only implemented prototype, shared reachable-set reuse between value fingerprint and anchor extraction, preserved output hashes but did not produce a stable median runtime improvement. It was removed.

arrow.query: nose query bench/repos/arrow all top=0 --mode semantic --format json
arrow.classification: remaining cost is real but small and dominated by class literal-table value construction; do not weaken class-data sensitivity to optimize it
arrow.next_safe_direction: A future fix needs a literal-table-specific fast path that emits the same value/literal/anchor hashes, or better internal timing to prove a narrower hot path.

minio.query: nose query bench/repos/minio all top=0 --mode semantic --format json
minio.classification: not a single Go value-graph hot path; the observed cost is split across lower/normalization passes and report shared-lines/render work
minio.next_safe_direction: Do not optimize a specific MinIO unit first. If MinIO remains important, measure lower-stage pass deltas with a dedicated lower profiler and compare cost per changed output family.

rejected_prototype.summary: Share the reachable value-node set between fingerprint/literal extraction and anchor extraction.
rejected_prototype.reason_rejected: The 5-run medians were within ordinary run-to-run noise and did not justify additional code complexity.
